The '''borgax''' was a species of creature [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] from [[Mutant|mutated]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of [[borgle bat]] and [[mawgax]].<ref name="SWG" />


==Biology==
Being a hybrid creature the borgax it has a head, legs and wings of a borgle bat (which are used as hind legs and ears) and a body and front legs of mawgax.
